title: Jensen Huang Returns to Nvidia Amid Ongoing Questions
subtitle: The CEO is back at work, but lawmakers and experts continue to debate the board's decision and national security concerns.

summary.en: Jensen Huang has returned as CEO of Nvidia after a very short time away from the company. His comeback follows a scandal involving an affair with a woman accused of being a foreign spy. While President Donald Trump supported his return, some lawmakers are demanding more information from intelligence agencies. Experts remain divided on whether the board acted correctly or ignored company values. The situation has raised new questions about executive accountability in the tech industry.
summary.zh: 黃仁勳在短暫離開輝達後已回任執行長。他的回歸源於一起涉及婚外情的醜聞，該名女子被指控為外國間諜。儘管川普總統支持他回歸，但部分國會議員仍要求情報機構提供更多資訊。專家對於董事會的決策是否正確，或是否忽視了公司價值觀仍存有分歧。此事件引發了關於科技產業高層問責制的新質疑。

paragraphs.en: Jensen Huang is back at the helm of Nvidia, but his return has not ended the controversy surrounding his leadership. Just days after being reinstated as CEO, the tech leader is facing intense pressure from both government officials and business experts. While Huang received a warm welcome from employees at the company’s headquarters, the path to his return remains a subject of heated debate in Washington and Silicon Valley.
paragraphs.zh: 黃仁勳 (Jensen Huang) 重掌輝達 (Nvidia) 兵符，但他的回歸並未平息圍繞其領導地位的爭議。這位科技業領袖在復職執行長短短幾天後，便面臨來自政府官員與商業專家的巨大壓力。儘管黃仁勳在公司總部受到了員工的熱烈歡迎，但他回歸的過程在華盛頓與矽谷仍是激烈辯論的焦點。

paragraphs.en: At an all-hands meeting held on Tuesday, Huang apologized for his actions, admitting that he had hurt his family and failed to follow the company's code of conduct. According to a livestream of the event viewed by The New York Times, he also addressed rumors about his return, stating that President Donald Trump did not force the board to rehire him. However, the circumstances of his departure and quick return have left many observers questioning the independence of Nvidia’s board of directors.
paragraphs.zh: 在週二舉行的全體員工大會上，黃仁勳為自己的行為道歉，承認他傷害了家人，且未能遵守公司的行為準則。根據《紐約時報》所觀看的活動直播，他也回應了關於他回歸的傳聞，表示川普 (Donald Trump) 總統並未強迫董事會重新聘用他。然而，他離職與迅速回歸的情況，讓許多觀察家質疑輝達董事會的獨立性。

paragraphs.en: NPR reports that the board is now facing criticism for how it handled the crisis. Experts in corporate governance note that boards exist to make careful, objective decisions that protect a company's long-term interests. Rob Lalka, a professor at Tulane’s Freeman School of Business, told NPR that many other companies have fired CEOs for similar behavior to protect their values and reputation. Lalka argued that Nvidia’s board essentially ignored its own investigation process to bring Huang back to power.
paragraphs.zh: 美國國家公共廣播電台 (NPR) 報導，董事會處理此次危機的方式正遭受批評。企業治理專家指出，董事會的存在是為了做出謹慎、客觀的決策，以維護公司的長期利益。杜蘭大學弗里曼商學院教授羅布·拉爾卡 (Rob Lalka) 向 NPR 表示，許多其他公司為了維護價值觀與聲譽，曾因類似行為開除執行長。拉爾卡認為，輝達董事會為了讓黃仁勳重掌大權，基本上無視了自身的調查程序。

paragraphs.en: On the other hand, some supporters believe Huang’s unique position makes him irreplaceable. Betsy Atkins, an experienced CEO and board member, told NPR that Huang is a genius founder who built a massive company from nothing. She argued that board members must use "nuanced business judgment" when facing such difficult situations, rather than just following a standard set of rules. This perspective highlights the tension between holding powerful leaders accountable and keeping a company's most important visionary in charge.
paragraphs.zh: 另一方面，部分支持者認為黃仁勳獨特的地位使他無可取代。資深執行長兼董事會成員貝琪·阿特金斯 (Betsy Atkins) 向 NPR 表示，黃仁勳是一位從零開始打造龐大企業的天才創辦人。她主張，董事會成員在面對此類棘手情況時，必須運用「細膩的商業判斷」，而非僅是遵循一套標準規則。這種觀點凸顯了在追究強勢領導者責任，與留住公司最重要的願景推動者之間，存在著緊張關係。

paragraphs.en: Beyond the boardroom, the situation has become a matter of national security. The scandal originally involved reports that the woman with whom Huang had an affair was a foreign intelligence asset. There were also concerns that she might have been involved in the illegal movement of Nvidia chips into China, which would violate U.S. export bans. However, according to a person familiar with the matter who spoke to NPR, U.S. intelligence officials have told congressional staff that there is no evidence the woman was a spy or that she started the relationship to collect secret information for a foreign government.
paragraphs.zh: 除了董事會之外，此事件已演變成國家安全問題。該醜聞最初涉及相關報導，指稱與黃仁勳發生婚外情的女子是外國情報資產。此外，外界也擔憂她可能涉及將輝達晶片非法轉移至中國，這將違反美國的出口禁令。然而，根據一位向 NPR 透露消息的知情人士指出，美國情報官員已告知國會幕僚，沒有證據顯示該女子是間諜，也沒有證據顯示她與黃仁勳交往是為了替外國政府蒐集機密資訊。

paragraphs.en: Despite this, some lawmakers are not satisfied. Representative Brian Fitzpatrick, a Republican from Pennsylvania, told NPR that he wants to hear directly from the FBI and CIA before Huang appears before a House committee next week. Fitzpatrick, a former FBI agent, believes the public deserves clear answers about what federal authorities knew and whether they warned the company about potential risks. He emphasized that the investigation must follow the facts wherever they lead, regardless of the CEO's status.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管如此，部分國會議員仍不滿意。來自賓州的共和黨眾議員布萊恩·費茲派屈克 (Brian Fitzpatrick) 向 NPR 表示，在黃仁勳下週出席眾議院委員會聽證會之前，他希望直接聽取聯邦調查局 (FBI) 與中央情報局 (CIA) 的說明。身為前 FBI 探員的費茲派屈克認為，大眾有權獲得明確答案，了解聯邦當局掌握了哪些資訊，以及他們是否曾向公司警告潛在風險。他強調，無論執行長的地位如何，調查都必須追隨事實真相。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, the BBC reports that Nvidia’s dominance in the artificial intelligence market is a major factor in why the company was so eager to have Huang back. Nvidia produces high-end computer chips that are considered the best in the world for driving AI technology. Because the U.S. AI industry relies heavily on these products, and because Huang has led the company for 33 years, he is viewed by many as a "cult figure" who is essential to the firm's success. This power has allowed him to remain in control even after the scandal broke.
paragraphs.zh: 與此同時，英國廣播公司 (BBC) 報導，輝達在人工智慧市場的統治地位，是公司如此渴望黃仁勳回歸的主要原因。輝達生產的高階電腦晶片被公認為推動人工智慧技術的世界頂尖產品。由於美國人工智慧產業高度依賴這些產品，加上黃仁勳已領導公司長達 33 年，許多人將他視為對公司成功至關重要的「偶像級人物」。這種影響力使他在醜聞爆發後，仍能穩坐領導大位。

paragraphs.en: For many, the return of the CEO is not just about one person, but about the culture of the entire tech industry. In Silicon Valley, advocates for better workplace standards have expressed alarm, noting that the incident raises serious questions about the limits of executive power. They worry that when a leader is seen as too important to fail, the rules that apply to everyone else seem to disappear.
paragraphs.zh: 對許多人而言，這位執行長的回歸不僅關乎個人，更涉及整個科技產業的文化。在矽谷，提倡改善職場標準的人士表達了擔憂，指出此事件引發了關於高層權力界限的嚴重質疑。他們擔心，當一位領導者被視為「大到不能倒」時，適用於其他所有人的規則似乎就會消失。

paragraphs.en: As the company moves forward, the focus will likely shift to how Nvidia manages its relationship with the U.S. government. With the Commerce Department already facing questions about chip exports, and lawmakers demanding more transparency, the pressure on the board to prove it is acting with "unimpeachable integrity"—or complete honesty—will likely continue. For now, Jensen Huang remains in charge, but the scrutiny of his leadership and the board's decision-making process is far from over.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著公司向前邁進，焦點可能會轉向輝達如何管理與美國政府的關係。由於商務部已面臨關於晶片出口的質詢，加上國會議員要求更高的透明度，董事會證明其行為具備「無懈可擊的誠信」（即完全誠實）的壓力可能會持續存在。目前，黃仁勳仍掌管公司，但對他領導風格與董事會決策過程的審視遠未結束。

keyTerms.definitionEn: A position of leadership or control over an organization.
keyTerms.noteZh: 原意為船舵，這裡引申為領導職位。文中：Jensen Huang is back at the helm of Nvidia, but his return has not ended the controversy surrounding his leadership.

常見於 phrasal verb 'all hands on deck'，這裡作形容詞修飾會議。文中：At an all-hands meeting held on Tuesday, Huang apologized for his actions, admitting that he had hurt his family and failed to follow the company's code of conduct.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To become public or known for the first time (used for news or scandals).
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作形容詞（破產的），這裡作動詞表示事件爆發。文中：This power has allowed him to remain in control even after the scandal broke.

quiz.question: What did Jensen Huang specifically address regarding his return during the all-hands meeting?

options.A: He confirmed that he had been pressured by President Trump to resume his role.
options.B: He denied rumors that his reappointment was forced by the President.
options.C: He apologized to the U.S. government for violating export bans.
options.D: He announced that he would step down again to protect the company's reputation.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案是 B。文章第二段明確指出，Huang 在全體員工會議上特別針對關於他回任的傳言進行說明，並澄清美國總統川普並沒有強迫董事會重新聘用他。選項 A 與文章事實相反；選項 C 中關於出口禁令的內容是在第五段提到的，並非他在會議上的道歉重點；選項 D 則完全未在文中提及。

quiz.question: Based on the article, why might the Nvidia board have been willing to overlook the scandal to bring Huang back?

options.A: They were afraid that the FBI would shut down the company if they didn't comply.
options.B: They believed the allegations against him were fabricated by his political rivals.
options.C: They valued his irreplaceable role in maintaining the company's technological dominance.
options.D: They were following a new corporate policy that prioritizes founder loyalty over ethics.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案是 C。文中第七段提到 Nvidia 在 AI 市場的統治地位，以及 Huang 作為帶領公司 33 年的「偶像級人物」對公司成功至關重要，這解釋了為何董事會即便在醜聞後仍急於讓他回歸。選項 A 文中並未提及；選項 B 雖然提到情報官員稱無證據顯示對方是間諜，但這不是董事會聘回他的主要原因；選項 D 則是錯誤推論，文中提到的是董事會被批評忽略了調查程序，而非有新政策。

quiz.question: In the final paragraph, what does the phrase 'unimpeachable integrity' mean?

options.A: A level of honesty that is impossible to criticize or doubt.
options.B: A legal requirement to disclose all private financial records.
options.C: A strategy to ignore public opinion during a corporate crisis.
options.D: A business practice that focuses solely on increasing profit margins.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案是 A。在文中最後一段，作者提到董事會面臨壓力，必須證明其行為具有「unimpeachable integrity」（無懈可擊的正直）。Unimpeachable 的字根為 impeach（彈劾/質疑），加上否定字首 un-，意指「無法被質疑的」。選項 B、C、D 皆與該詞彙的定義無關，且不符合文中強調公司需展現完全誠實以應對政府審查的語境。

quiz.question: What is the central conflict presented in this article?

options.A: The legal battle between the U.S. government and Nvidia over illegal chip exports to China.
options.B: The personal struggle of Jensen Huang to clear his name after a false scandal.
options.C: The tension between holding a powerful, essential leader accountable and the board's desire to maintain business stability.
options.D: The debate over whether AI technology should be controlled by a single private company.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案是 C。本文的核心在於探討當一位對公司極其重要的領導者（如 Jensen Huang）發生醜聞時，企業治理、道德標準與商業利益之間的拉扯。文章從董事會的決策、政府的壓力、到業界對執行長權力限制的擔憂，皆圍繞此核心衝突展開。選項 A 只是事件細節之一；選項 B 過度簡化了問題；選項 D 雖有提及 AI 產業影響，但並非本文論述的主軸。
